Indian Standard
METHODS OF TEST FOR CORRUGATED FIBREBOARD
PART II EDGEWISE CRUSH RESISTANCE OF BOARD

0. FOREWORD
Standard ( Part II ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 29 July 1976, after the draft finalized by the Paper and Flexible Packaging Sectional Committee had been approved by the Marine, Cargo Movement and Packaging Division Council. 0.2 The increasing use of corrugated fibreboard for transport containers has The growing demand for given an impetus to this industry for expansion. this product has brought to the fore the need of evaluating the various physical characteristics of the corrugated board. The standards on test methods for determining these characteristics are covered in following parts for proper evaluation and reproducibility of the test results under different conditions: Methods of test for corrugated IS : 7063 ( Part I )-I973 Part I Thickness of board fibreboard:

0.1 This Indian

IS : 7063 ( Part II )- 1976 Methods of test for corrugated fibreboard: Part II Edgewise crush resistance of board Methods of test for corrugated fibreboard: IS : 7063 ( Part III )-1976 Part III Water resistance of the glue bond by immersion Methods of test for corrugated fibreboard: IS : 7063 ( Part IV )-1976 Part IV Determination of substance of the component papers after separation 0.3 Edgewise crush resistance of corrugated fibreboard is used for two purposes to indicate (a) edgewise rigidity of the board, and (b) the probable This data would help the crushing resistance of the finished container. designer for specifying a suitable corrugated board container to resist the compression force expected to be encountered in shipment and storage. 0.4 For international coordination and recognition this standard has been based on IS0 3037 ` Corrugated fibreboard - Determination of edgewise crush resistance `, issued by the International Organization for Standardization. 3
